from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyConstructionObservation(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a residential construction report."""
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was released (YYYY-MM-DD format)")
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month for which the data is reported (YYYY-MM format)")
    permits_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total building permits")
    starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for total housing starts")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the SAAR values (e.g., 'thousands' or 'units')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    monthly_observations: list[MonthlyConstructionObservation]
